description.value:
You touch a creature suffering a poison or disease and synthesize a chakra-based countermeasure from their own blood chemistry. Attempt a counteract check against the affliction; counteract rank equals your spell rank, and the modifier is your spellcasting attribute modifier + your Medicine proficiency bonus.

If the affliction has stages, success reduces it by 1 stage and the target rolls a fresh save against the next-stage interval immediately at +2 status bonus.

Heightened (+1) Counteract rank increases by 1.

target.value: 1 willing creature suffering a poison or disease
